margin.title: Profitability
margin.description: Realized revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin for the selected range. Cost comes from the exact lots consumed on each sale, falling back to the product cost when a line is not lot-tracked.
margin.error: The profitability report could not be loaded.

byProduct.title: By product
byProduct.emptyState: There are no completed sales in the selected dates. Adjust the range to see profitability by product.

dayClose.title: Day close
dayClose.description: Review the complete business-day evidence before manager sign-off: sales, tenders, cash sessions, fiscal documents, adjustments, and anomaly signals.
dayClose.error: The day-close report could not be loaded.

readiness.ready: The day is ready for manager review
readiness.blocked: The day still has blocking work

signoff.title: Manager sign-off
signoff.description: Confirm your review to freeze this exact report as the business day's permanent evidence.
signoff.blocked: Resolve the blocking items above before this report can be signed.
signoff.attestation: I reviewed this report and confirm that it represents the business day shown.
signoff.confirmMessage: This action is irreversible. The report for {{date}}, generated at {{generatedAt}}, will be stored exactly as shown and cannot be edited or deleted.
signoff.signedDescription: This screen is showing the immutable signed snapshot. Activity recorded later does not rewrite it.
signoff.pdfUnavailable: This older signed record predates stored PDF artifacts. Its immutable report remains available on this screen.
signoff.pdfDownloadedDescription: The stored artifact passed its size and SHA-256 integrity checks.
signoff.pdfDownloadError: The signed PDF could not be verified and downloaded
signoff.successDescription: The immutable report and its audit evidence were saved.
signoff.errorTitle: The day close could not be signed

payments.note: Gross tenders for sales recorded on this day; voids and refunds appear separately under adjustments.

empty.paymentsDescription: No eligible sale tenders were recorded for this business day.

coverage.description: The report stays explicit when a domain has no source model; it never converts missing evidence into a false zero.

commissions_not_tracked.title: Commissions
commissions_not_tracked.description: Commission plans are not modeled yet, so this report marks the section unavailable instead of reporting zero.

waste_not_tracked.title: Waste
waste_not_tracked.description: Waste events are not modeled yet, so this report marks the section unavailable instead of hiding the gap.

accounting.title: Accountant export
accounting.description: Export completed sales and refunds in their accounting period as files for Siigo, Alegra, World Office or any bookkeeping system. Company-specific vendor codes ship blank on purpose — your accountant maps them once.

filters.siteSaved: This site selection will be used the next time this company opens the export.
filters.siteSaveError: The site preference could not be saved.
filters.siteLoadError: Sites could not be loaded. Accounting export remains disabled.
filters.invalidRange: Choose complete dates with From on or before To. No accounting request or export will run until the range is valid.

accounting.truncated: This period returned more accounting events than one export can carry, so the file would be incomplete. Export in shorter periods (or filter by site) before handing anything to your accountant.

empty.title: No accounting events in this range
empty.description: Adjust the dates to a period with sales or refund activity.

siigo.title: Siigo (sales invoices)
siigo.description: CSV with the documented Siigo Nube sales-invoice columns, one row per product line and up to 500 rows per file. Large periods download as one ZIP. Fill company-specific codes before uploading; a real Siigo account has not validated the import yet.
siigo.multiFile: One ZIP was downloaded with {{count}} capped CSV files.
siigo.exportError: The Siigo archive could not be created. No partial download was produced.

journal.title: Journal entries (Alegra)
journal.description: One balanced entry per sale or refund event, dated in its accounting period, over editable default PUC accounts. Import via the column-mapping importer.

settings.title: PUC account configuration
settings.description: Version {{version}} defaults are saved per company. Use 4 to 12 digits starting from 1 to 9 for account or auxiliary codes; exports never guess vendor-specific mappings.
settings.codeHint: Use 4 to 12 digits and do not start with zero. Siigo, Alegra and World Office compatibility still requires a real importer test with your accountant.
settings.loadError: The PUC configuration could not be loaded. Journal export remains disabled.
settings.saveError: The PUC configuration could not be saved.

generic.title: Accounting detail (generic)
generic.description: Every sale and refund line with signed taxes, payments and fiscal references — for World Office or any system with a template-mapping import.

accounting.unreconciled: {{count}} sale(s) have taxes that do not match their lines ({{sales}}). Exporting them would misclassify tax as income; resolve them before exporting.
accounting.paymentUnreconciled: {{count}} refund(s) do not match their recorded payment destinations ({{sales}}). Exporting them would invent or move money between accounts; repair the records before exporting.
accounting.siigoCollision: Two sales from different sites share the same invoice number ({{consecutives}}), and Siigo would merge them into one document. Export one site at a time using the site filter.
